cases.positive: Actual Production PostgreSQL + filestore matches attachment hashes; roles/limits/backup known
cases.negative: Unproven second DB instantiated or attachment exists only as SQL row with missing file

cases.positive: Immutable W/# source cohort and exact suffixed RefID match uniquely to transaction
cases.negative: P/E/B silently imported; partner/date/fuzzy match used; unmatched coerced

cases.positive: Two different originals on same worksheet each import once with hashes
cases.negative: Second image overwritten, source ImageID duplicates, multi-page corrupted

cases.positive: Census equations and replay created=0; unmatched/corrupt quarantined
cases.negative: Missing or ambiguous source counted as success or creates guessed transaction

cases.positive: File opens with original bytes through Enterprise Documents after restore
cases.negative: PG row counts correct but native file missing or unreadable

cases.positive: Installed licensed native document AI extracts candidate with original/page evidence
cases.negative: AI guesses a field, overwrites verification, posts invoice, triggers matching/enrichment

cases.positive: Blurry/stale/contradictory record flags assigned manager with exact source and reason
cases.negative: No manager notification, unauthorized user sees review, auto-corrected truth

cases.positive: Manager resolves with audited original and role; repeated AI run no duplicate open case
cases.negative: Low confidence auto-approved, wrong company, no audit, resolved issue reopens without new evidence

cases.positive: Signed ERP AP/AR/inventory + QB TB/controls + bank statements same cutoff/sha
cases.negative: No report, stale bank date, currency mismatch or generic source status guessed

cases.positive: Approved operations exception reopens selected closed historical once with reason
cases.negative: Unpaid invoice alone activates trade, role bypass, rerun double-reopens

cases.positive: Make command dry-run, permit guard, source SHA and replay yields 0 extra actions
cases.negative: Target missing, source mismatch, partial failure silently swallowed, unrestricted Production writes

cases.positive: Partial paid customer invoice opens residual only; historical gross remains Draft
cases.negative: Original historical invoice posted, duplicate tax/revenue or full gross posted again

cases.positive: Vendor bill and refunds preserve signed residual and clearing per currency
cases.negative: Wrong sign credit, zero residual opens document, company/partner mismatch

cases.positive: QB TB debits == credits and AR/AP control replaced by clearing; both clearing return zero
cases.negative: Direct native control amount doubled, nonzero clearing silently written off

cases.positive: Statement balance and timing adjustments reconcile to QB cash at cutoff
cases.negative: Bank balance inferred from payment status or fabricated Odoo payment

cases.positive: ERP physical quantity/valuation accepted and QB book value tied with approved variance
cases.negative: Fake picking/receipt created, missing stock count treated as zero

cases.positive: Replay signed cutoff manifest generates zero new postings; changed report requires new permit
cases.negative: Mutates posted originals or changes source evidence silently

cases.positive: Production posting occurs only with signed human approval and matched one-writer cutoff
cases.negative: An import, transaction reopen, cron or Make dry-run posts to real GL

cases.positive: Native prechange DB+filestore backup restored in isolated Odoo with original docs
cases.negative: Backup list screenshot only or filestore omitted

cases.positive: Independent AWS cold-path actual source restore plus attachment hash and QB/AR/AP sample
cases.negative: Restores data rows without filestore, relies on Odoo.sh or original Mac

cases.positive: Operator can retrieve 1Password pack in clean room, prove last good checkpoint
cases.negative: A developer local ZIP or unfinished Git PR is only copy

cases.positive: Fresh 2h source and four schedule points separately proven where supported
cases.negative: Stale daily backup relabeled four times to claim 2h RPO

release_policy.positive_receipt: Actual tagged source/build/company/role logs and accounting/recovery evidence
release_policy.negative: A known failure blocks PASS until fixed, invalidated or explicitly dispositioned
